missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend a dose until age/life stage, dietary sources and current products are known; clinical testing only where indicated.
safety_exclusions: Do not diagnose deficiency from sun exposure alone.
Do not encourage unprotected UV exposure as treatment.
Do not recommend high-dose vitamin D without clinical indication.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease, hypercalcemia, kidney stones, malabsorption, pregnancy or abnormal 25(OH)D/calcium results.
population_and_context: Adults reporting limited sun exposure; low sun exposure alone does not diagnose vitamin D deficiency or establish a personalized dose.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Use life-stage reference values and clinical assessment where indicated; avoid high-dose protocols from questionnaire data.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin D fact sheet describes multiple determinants of status; low sun exposure is not a diagnostic test. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
